description:
Generate tools for the Draftless AI creative studio. Requires sign-in to run. Actions:
- generate_one_take_ad: Proven one-take ad method, step by step (ads.one_take is the board-gated flow).
- generate_image: Generate an image from a text prompt as the signed-in user.
- generate_video: Submit a video generation job as the signed-in user.
- generate_audio: Generate audio as the signed-in user and save it to the Asset Library.
- execute_node: Execute a single AI node as the signed-in user — generate an image, video, audio, 3D model, SVG, or text; analyze/relight/outpaint/inpaint/u
- execute_chain: Run up to 10 AI nodes in sequence, wiring each step's outputs into the next.
- generate_batch: Run up to 10 independent AI node executions concurrently as the signed-in user.
- generate_image_layers: Separate a single image into individually editable layers (background plate plus each distinct object, each a transparent PNG with its own b
- generate_layered_poster: NOT AVAILABLE YET: switched off until the /layers poster editor ships (it answers 'not available yet').
- generate_3d: Submit an asynchronous 3D job as the signed-in user: image-to-3D, text-to-3D, multi-view-to-3D, rigging of an existing mesh, or text-to-moti
- generate_headshots: Generate one professional AI headshot of a person and save it to the user's Asset Library.
- generate_try_on: Virtually try a garment on a person image and save the result to the user's Asset Library.
- plan_saas_video: Writes a SaaS launch film for a product (the same engine as Draftless SaaS Video): the copy, the product UI it shows, its motion, and the EX
- create_saas_video: Renders a film planned by plan_saas_video.
- get_saas_video: Status of a create_saas_video render: { status, progress, resultUrl (signed MP4 when done), error, refunded }.
- plan_story_film: One prompt → a story-led product launch film: two named people in two places, the product's REAL captured pages and components driven by a n
- get_story_plan: The plan started by plan_story_film: { status: 'planning' } while the story is written, then { status: 'ready', ok, storyboard, credits, cei
- create_story_film: Starts the film planned by plan_story_film: pass its plan_id (once get_story_plan says ready), accepted_credits = the plan's `credits` and a
- get_story_film: Status of a create_story_film run: { status, items, director: { phase, error, log, filmUrl } }.
- create_story_rerender: For a create_story_film run whose edit or render FAILED after its takes were made: cuts the stored takes again and renders, with no new gene

input.description: Arguments for the action (see discover.describe_action once signed in).

name: generate
